lines.text: Here's what my file cabinets say, and I've got forty years of them: the shapes come in waves. Foo fighters in the war - glowing balls, before any movie. Discs from '47 - the pictures came after, not before. Big silent triangles through the eighties and nineties - decades before Hollywood made a triangle anybody remembers. And now? Orbs and tic-tacs.
